responsibility: Provides the processor pipeline and issue model for the PowerPC 440 core family. The file declares the 440’s dual-issue automata and i/j/l/f pipes, then maps GCC rs6000 instruction types to reservation/latency rules for integer, load/store, branch, compare, multiply/divide, and floating-point operations, supplying the target-specific scheduling data consumed by the RTL scheduler for -mcpu=440.
